description.en: Data used by MarSim (Mars EVA map and planner). Generated from data/missions/mount-sharp/provenance.json plus live feeds.

area.name: Bagnold dunes, foot of Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons), Gale crater

en: Mastcam / rover images: the WP2 view is a render from the HiRISE DTM, not a photograph

Syntetyczne dane przykładowe w data/demo/ (tylko bez backendu)
